answer_1.quote: We evaluate the dialogue quality generated by OmniFlatten using high-performing LLMs as evaluators, and evaluate the turn-taking performance... Our contributions can be summarized as follows: • We propose a novel End-to-End GPT-based model OmniFlatten, capable of effectively modeling the complex behaviors inherent to natural human-like dialogues, with low latency.

answer_2.quote: For TTS evaluation, we use the model to generate speech tokens... we compute Word Error Rate (WER) for English datasets and Character Error Rate (CER) for Chinese datasets. We also evaluate the audio quality of the TTS output ... using UTMOS. ... Assistant Turn-taking and User Turn-taking accuracy at the k-th token (Acc@K) and Response Time.

answer_3.quote: We evaluate the full-duplex dialogue capabilities of OmniFlatten, by prompting a competitive text LLM to evaluate the semantics of dialogues and assign a score on the predicted assistant response... The scoring mechanism involves designing a specific prompt and utilizing a competitive text LLM, QWen-max model, to rate the responses from the model on a scale of 1 to 10 points.
